description: This Java class defines a custom bottom sheet dialog for sharing notes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages UI elements, handles user interactions for sharing options, and applies branding styles.

classes.name: NoteShareActivityShareItemActionBottomSheetDialog
classes.description: A bottom sheet dialog for managing sharing actions on a note, including UI updates and branding.

methods.name: NoteShareActivityShareItemActionBottomSheetDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with activity context, sharing actions, and share data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog UI, sets layout, and configures show behavior.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates visibility of sharing options based on share type and security.

methods.name: setupClickListener
methods.description: Sets click listeners for sharing options, invoking corresponding actions.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up binding reference when dialog stops.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to UI elements based on provided color.
